put.description: Replaces all fields of an existing user. The user ID in the path must exist.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a user by marking them inactive. The user ID must exist.

patch.summary: Update user role and active status
patch.description: Partial update -- only role and active status. Never accepts a password; use PUT for a full replace including password.

put.description: USER role can only update if unit.horarioFijo == false. ADMIN always proceeds.

403.description: USER cannot modify a fixed schedule

put.summary: Deactivate a unit — removes it from dispatch
Activate a unit — enables it for dispatch

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all users. Supports page number, page size, and sorting.

post.description: Creates a new user with unique username. Returns the created user and its location.

400.description: Validation failed (e.g., blank username, invalid role)

post.summary: Stop the active dispatch round for a unit

204.description: Round stopped — no further dispatches will occur

409.description: No active round for this unit

post.description: Schedule window must be configured first via PUT /api/units/{numUnidad}/schedule. coordinateMode=MANUAL requires lat and lon. coordinateMode=AUTOMATIC is reserved for Phase 6 (TraccarCoordinateAdapter).

204.description: Round started — tick will dispatch on the next qualifying interval

400.description: Invalid or missing coordinates, or unsupported coordinateMode

409.description: Round already active / unit inactive / schedule not configured

post.summary: Test dispatch path with caller-supplied coordinates
post.description: Builds a GpsReading from the provided lat/lon without calling the configured GpsCoordinateProvider or QSolutions. Useful for verifying coordinate validation and response format with known safe values.

400.description: lat or lon is null, out of range, or (0,0)

post.summary: Force-dispatch a GPS pulse for a single unit with operator-supplied coordinates
post.description: Bypasses the schedule window check. coordinateMode=MANUAL requires lat and lon. coordinateMode=AUTOMATIC uses live Traccar GPS coordinates from cache (503 if unavailable or stale).

204.description: Pulse dispatched and confirmed by QSolutions

400.description: Invalid or missing coordinates, or unsupported coordinateMode

get.summary: Receive GPS push from Traccar Client (HTTP GET / OsmAnd protocol)
get.description: Public endpoint required by OsmAnd protocol. Uses GET with query params. Unknown unit IDs are silently accepted. Invalid coordinates return 400.

post.summary: Receive GPS push from Traccar Client (HTTP POST / OsmAnd protocol)
post.description: Public endpoint for Traccar Client's HTTP POST mode. The real client sends the same OsmAnd-style fields (id, lat, lon, timestamp, accuracy, altitude, batt, charge) as an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body, not a JSON payload — Spring binds form-urlencoded POST parameters the same way as query parameters. Unknown unit IDs are silently accepted. Invalid coordinates return 400.
Issues a new access token using the refresh_token httpOnly cookie. Old refresh token is revoked (single-use rotation). No request body.

401.description: Refresh token cookie missing, invalid, expired, or revoked

post.description: Blacklists the access token in Redis, revokes the refresh token in DB (when present), and clears the refresh_token cookie
Validates credentials. Returns the access token in the body; the refresh token is delivered exclusively via an httpOnly cookie, never in the response body.

get.summary: Get a single unit by its identifier
Test the configured GPS provider for a unit
get.description: Returns the coordinates from the configured GpsCoordinateProvider. Never dispatches to QSolutions.

503.description: Configured GPS provider unavailable for this unit

get.summary: List pulse log entries with optional filters
get.description: Returns paginated dispatch history. All filters are optional.

get.summary: Grouped dispatch counts by status for a single day
get.description: Defaults to today (fleet timezone) if 'date' is omitted. Scoped to pulse-log stats only -- unit-active counts come from GET /api/units.
